svg.desc: ScadaCraft OpenBridge widget: Radial gauge (obc-gauge-radial, OpenBridge 1.0.0, Apache-2.0). Library: OpenBridge · Instruments. Box 192x192 px, anchor at (0,0). Bindable properties: _pn_value (default 0, read): Process value _pn_min (default 0, read): Scale minimum _pn_max (default 100, read): Scale maximum _pb_hasSetpoint (default false, read): Show the setpoint marker _pn_setpoint (default 0, read): Setpoint (shown when _pb_hasSetpoint is true) _ps_type (default 'filled', read): Style: filled | bar | needle _pb_labels (default true, read): Show scale labels _ps_priority (default 'regular', read): Colour priority: regular | enhanced _pb_off (default false, read): Instrument off (greyed out)
